gate: Faults are caught on held-out batches

split.method: per campaign (recipe 1-30, operator 31-60, Raman/PAT 61-90): 20 train, 5 calibration, 5 test; batches 91-100 (faults) are test only

definitions.alarm: the monitoring statistic exceeds its control limit for `persistence` consecutive readings (one reading = 0.2 h); the alarm time is the last of those readings
definitions.fault_detected: a fault batch raises an alarm at or after its first fault_ref > 0 reading, before the batch ends
definitions.detection_delay_h: alarm time minus the first fault_ref > 0 time
definitions.false_alarm_batch: a held-out normal batch that raises any alarm, or a fault batch that raises an alarm before its fault starts

rules: Model fitting uses train batches only; limits and the persistence setting use calibration batches only (plus synthetic faults injected into calibration batches).

Test batches (15 normal + 10 fault) are scored once, by models/evaluate.py, against frozen model artifacts. No setting is changed after seeing test results; any later change is a new, separately reported run.
The fault_ref and fault_flag columns are never features.
